drafts.description: A photograph dating to 1932 - 1942 from Quneitra, Syria, in the Circassian diaspora, featuring Amin Ayob Samgugh (1903-1952) with students of the Adyghe School in front of a black stone building. drafts.description: A 1908 photograph by Semyon Afanasyevich Shavlovsky from the first Circassian charity evening in Ekaterinodar (Krasnodar city), Russia, featuring four actors in Circassian warrior costumes, one of them Sultan Dovlet-Girey (1875-1918). Sultan Dovlet-Girey was the author of the theatrical production Kunchuk's Attack, staged at the evening. The evening was held on 18 January 1908; a second evening followed in 1914, after the Xasa (the association) was established there, and an album was made for each evening. The photograph is held at the National Museum of Adygea.
